require "json"
require "digest"
require "rails"
require "rails/command"
require "rails/commands/server/server_command"
phase = ARGV.fetch(0)
command = Rails::Command::ServerCommand.new([], [])
options = command.server_options
v = {marker: ENV.fetch("QA364_MARKER", "LOCAL"), phase: phase, ruby: RUBY_VERSION, rails: Rails.version, rails_env_present: ENV.key?("RAILS_ENV"), rails_env: ENV["RAILS_ENV"], rack_env_present: ENV.key?("RACK_ENV"), rack_env: ENV["RACK_ENV"], rails_environment: Rails.env.to_s, server_environment: options[:environment], host: options[:Host], port: options[:Port], binding: ENV["BINDING"]}
if File.exist?("../qa364-reference.json")
  reference = JSON.parse(File.read("../qa364-reference.json"))
  observed = reference.fetch("files").to_h { |n, expected| bytes = File.binread(File.join("..", n)); [n, {"bytes" => bytes.bytesize, "sha256" => Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(bytes)}] }
  raise "public source changed" unless observed == reference.fetch("files")
  v[:git_source_files] = observed
end
File.write("qa364-#{phase}.json", JSON.generate(v))
puts "QA364_OBSERVER #{JSON.generate(v)}"
STDOUT.flush
